toni-dx: Heads-up: onboarding sample broke after SDK publish added an exports map. Edge sample (Next edge + Wrangler) ends up pulling CJS and crashes with `TypeError: sdk.default is not a function`. TS lost types too.

rafa-sdk: Which sample/version? quick steps to repro?

toni-dx: sample/edge-playground @1.4.0. Repro: pnpm i @redwood/sdk@1.4.0 -> next dev -> call /api/llm.

eli-edge: Looking at tarball: dist/types missing and exports only has import/require. Many edge bundlers prefer a different conditional and fall back to require.

rafa-sdk: package.json snippet from npm pack:
```
{"name":"@redwood/sdk","version":"1.4.0","main":"dist/cjs/index.js","module":"dist/esm/index.mjs","types":"dist/types/index.d.ts","exports":{".":{"import":"dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"dist/cjs/index.js"}}}
```

sam-ci: CI flagged integration failure: tests/edge/onboard.test.js -> import error.

eli-edge: Short-term workarounds: pin to 1.3.x, or alias to dist/esm in bundler. Long-term: include types in package, add `edge` conditional, and supply a `default` fallback to help older resolvers. Example proposal:
```
"exports":{
  ".":{
    "edge":"dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "import":"dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require":"dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default":"dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

toni-dx: Also add files array so types don't get skipped, and run `npm pack` smoke tests in publish pipeline.

rafa-sdk: I'll cut a patch to include types + files list. I'll also add a tiny edge integration that installs the tarball as part of smoke tests.

build-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/599 with repro and CI logs. Assigned to rafa-sdk + eli-edge.

sam-ci: Once patch is out, I'll unpin sample and re-run edge suite. Thanks for the quick catch.
